title: Penny round mosaic in hexagonal or square packing
purpose: Generate tileable PBR maps of penny round mosaic: small domed round tiles in hexagonal close packing or on a square grid, with grout between, hand-set offsets, glaze rings and a colour rule (weighted blend, scattered accents or drifting clusters). Use for bathroom floors, shower walls and backsplashes.

contract.signature: generate(width=256, height=256, seed=0, preset="default", directx_normal=False, **parameters) -> {map name: {"channels", "colour_space", "pixels"}}
contract.command_line: python penny_round_mosaic.py --size 1024 --seed 7 --preset NAME --out DIR [--width W --height H] [--set NAME=VALUE] [--directx-normal] [--orm]

parameters.name: packing
parameters.meaning: 0 hexagonal close packing (rows offset by half a round), 1 square grid.

parameters.name: pattern
parameters.meaning: Colour rule: 0 weighted random blend of the palette, 1 a base colour with scattered accents, 2 clusters that drift between the palette colours.

parameters.name: gap
parameters.meaning: Grout between neighbouring rounds as a share of the round spacing.

parameters.name: dome
parameters.meaning: How much each round's face bulges toward its centre.

parameters.name: handmade
parameters.meaning: Random offsets and size changes of the rounds, as on hand-set sheets.

parameters.name: grout_depth
parameters.meaning: How far the grout sits below the rounds.

parameters.name: accent_share
parameters.meaning: Share of accent rounds (pattern 1) or of the second colour in the random blend (pattern 0).

parameters.name: colour_variation
parameters.meaning: Spread of tone between rounds of one colour.

parameters.name: dirt
parameters.meaning: Darkening of the grout and the round edges.

parameters.name: hue_shift
parameters.meaning: Hue rotation of the albedo in turns.

presets.name: default
presets.description: White glossy penny rounds in hexagonal packing with mid grey grout.

presets.name: salt_pepper
presets.description: Matte white rounds with scattered black ones and white grout.

presets.name: sage_blend
presets.description: Glossy green rounds drifting between sage and moss, uneven hand-set rows.

presets.name: porcelain_grid
presets.description: Unglazed speckled terracotta rounds on a square grid with dark grout.

limits: Rounds are discs with a bullnose edge and a domed face; mesh-backed sheet seams, cut rounds at walls and glaze crazing are not modelled. In hexagonal packing the even row count squashes the lattice by about 1 percent for most column counts, more for very few columns. The colour rules are random or noise-driven, not designed motifs. Occlusion is a blurred-height estimate, not ray traced.
technique_references: Hexagonal close packing in odd-row offset coordinates
Nearest of four candidate centres with per-round jitter
Disc distance field with a quarter-circle bullnose profile
Value-noise clusters sampled at round centres for colour drift
Height to tangent-space normal by central differences
